chapter.heading: A Song of Praise to God Coming in Judgment
chapter.v:
Oh, sing
to the Lord a new song!Sing to the Lord, all the earth. [Is. 58:2; Jer.]

Sing to
the Lord, bless His name;Proclaim the good news of His salvation from day to day. [Is. 10:20; Jer. 7:4; 21:2; Mic. 3:11; Rom. 2:17] [Is. 52:1; 64:10]

Declare His
glory among the nations,His wonders among all peoples. [Is. 44:7, 8; 46:10 e Josh. 21:45; Is. 42:9]

For the
Lord is great and greatly to be praised;He is to be feared above all gods. [Ex. 32:9; Deut. 31:27; Ezek. 2:4; 3:7]

For all
the gods of the peoples are idols,But the Lord made the heavens.

Honor and
majesty are before Him;Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.

Give to
the Lord, O families of the peoples,Give to the Lord glory and strength.

Give to
the Lord the glory due His name;Bring an offering, and come into His courts. [Deut. 9:7, 24; Ps. 58:3; Is. 46:3,]

Oh, worship
the Lord in the beauty of holiness!Tremble before Him, all the earth. [Ps. 79:9; 106:8; Is. 43:25; Ezek. i [Neh. 9:30, 31]; Ps. 78:38; Is. 30:18;]

Say among
the nations, “The Lord reigns;The world also is firmly established,It shall not be moved;He shall judge the peoples righteously.” [Ps. 66:10; Jer. 9:7 k Deut. 4:20; 1 Kin. 8:51; Jer.]

Let the
heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad;Let the sea roar, and all its fullness;

Let the
field be joyful, and all that is in it.Then all the trees of the woods will rejoice before the Lord. [Is. 44:6; [Rev.] [Deut. 32:39]

For He
is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth.He shall judge the world with righteousness,And the peoples with His truth. [Ex. 20:11; Ps. 102:25; Is. 42:5; 45:12, 18; Heb. 1:10-12 q Is. 40:26]
